decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted for an extension to a public house shall not be commenced until full details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airbourne and impact sound has been submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority, and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given. (Reason: To prevent noise disturbance to nearby properties.)
Condition : 5 - The windows shown in the southern facing flank wall of the extension hereby permitted shall be installed as non-opening windows to remain fixed closed and retained as such.

Condition : 6 - The development shall not be occupied until conifer screen planting proposed on plans along the southern boundary of the site have been planted in accordance with a scheme submitted to and approved in writing with the local planning authority.

Condition : 7 - Before the development hereby permitted commences, a scheme detailing ALL species types, heights and planting positions for plants in the landscaped buffer strips on the eastern and southern boundaries should be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These plants shall be planted during the first available planting season in 2001, and be replaced with a species of similar maturity if they die.

Condition : 8 - Before the extension hereby permitted is occupied or used, details and specifications of the type of acoustic barrier/fence to be erected along part of the the southern boundary of the site shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the local planning authority and then erected. Thereafter the fence shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority. (Reason C29)

10	J1 - Disabled access - proposed wording
The access doorways to the new extension, and layout and doorways to the new WC hereby permitted shall have a minimum clear width of 900mm, a level surface or ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
